# Supabase browser client

- Package: `@supabase/supabase-js`, version `2.49.8`, UMD browser build.
- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.49.8/dist/umd/supabase.js
- Upstream: https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js
- License: MIT (see `supabase-LICENSE.txt`).
- Kept locally so loading the board does not depend on a CDN at runtime.
- This is an unmodified third-party build. Application configuration is in
  `../supabase-config.js`; no account credentials belong in this directory.
